appearance_facts.fact: Title block reads 'Telehealth Follow-up Enrollment Trend' with subtitle 'Reported window shown in the dashboard summary'. Chart area spans roughly x=130-910, y=150-810.
A single teal line with four circular markers rises monotonically from lower-left to upper-right, indicating a steady upward slope across the displayed years.
Leftmost data marker sits at the lowest vertical position on the line, aligned with the 260 gridline.
Second marker is positioned higher than the first, near the 290-300 vertical band.
Third marker is higher still, near the 330-340 vertical band.
Rightmost marker is the highest point on the line, near the 370-380 vertical band.
No downward segments, flat plateaus, or dips are visible; the line is a continuous straight ascending segment connecting the four markers.
Faint horizontal gridlines run across the plot at the labeled y-tick levels; no reference lines, bands, or secondary series are present.

printed_facts.fact: Y-axis tick values from top to bottom: 380, 350, 320, 290, 260.
Series values by year: 2017 ≈ 260; 2018 ≈ 295-300; 2019 ≈ 335-340; 2020 ≈ 370-375. No per-point numeric annotations are printed.

public_definitions: Sustained growth planning: an enrollment pattern that indicates broad multi-year expansion.
Ongoing monitoring: a more recent enrollment upswing that still warrants observation.
Decline-response assessment: an enrollment pattern consistent with a downward trajectory.
uncertain: The task review window is stated as 2013-2020, but the displayed axis and data begin at 2017; no 2013-2016 values are shown, so the full-window pattern cannot be confirmed from the chart alone.
Exact per-year values are not labeled; readings are estimated from gridline alignment (e.g., 2018 between 290 and 320, 2019 between 320 and 350, 2020 between 350 and 380).
